sanskrit: dyaur javenā pṛthivī varimṇāntarikṣaṃ mahitvāpo bhūmnā | devasya tvā savituḥ prasave 'śvinor bāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ prasūto brāhmaṇebhyo nir vapāmi ||
english: Heaven by its swiftness, Earth by its breadth, the atmosphere by its greatness, the waters by their abundance — by the impulse of the god Savitṛ, with the arms of the Aśvins, with the hands of Pūṣan, impelled forth, I pour thee out for the Brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit: ṛṣibhyas tvā rṣeyebhyas tvā (nir vapāmi) ||
english: For the ṛṣis, for the seers' lineages, I pour thee out.

sanskrit: juṣṭatamaṃ vahnitamaṃ papritamaṃ sasnitamam ūrjo bhāgam akṣitam akṣitaye nir vapāmi ||
english: The most beloved, the best borne, the most filling, the most nutritious — the imperishable portion of vital strength, for the sake of imperishability I pour thee out.

sanskrit: vasavas tvā gāyatreṇa chandasā nir vapantu ||
english: May the Vasus pour thee out with the Gāyatrī metre.

sanskrit: rudrās tvā traiṣṭubhena chandasā nir vapantu ||
english: May the Rudras pour thee out with the Triṣṭubh metre.

sanskrit: ādityās tvā jāgatena chandasā nir vapantu ||
english: May the Ādityas pour thee out with the Jagatī metre.

sanskrit: idam abhirāvṇām idam abhigatvarāṇām idam abhimanyūnām ||
english: This is for those who shout against us; this for those who rush against us; this for those who bear malice against us.

sanskrit: yathā kūpaḥ śatakhāḥ sahasrakhā nopadasyati | evedaṃ mopa dasat tīrtham aśvinor iva ||
english: Just as a well of a hundred channels, a well of a thousand channels, fails not — so may this not fail us, like the ford of the Aśvins.

sanskrit: yo no dveṣan manasā yaś ca vācā daivye loka uta mānuṣe yaḥ | grāvṇā hantu mahatā tasya sarvam indro devo maghavāñ chacīpatiḥ ||
english: Whoever hates us in mind and whoever in speech, in the divine world or in the human — may Indra the god, the bounteous, the lord of Śacī, smite all of him with the great pressing-stone.

sanskrit: vīrutsu vastraṃ parijāyaitad ūrjā soma punar ā viśeha naḥ | dṛṃhasva bāhvo amba dhṛṣva mā riṣo agniś caitat saniṣyatha ||
english: This garment, born among plants — O Soma, enter us again here with vital strength. Be firm, O Mother of arms, be bold; suffer no harm — Agni shall obtain this for you.

sanskrit: devīr āpa ūrjo bhāgāya vo 'kṣitā akṣitaya ā siñcāmi ||
english: O divine Waters, for a share of vital strength I pour you in, imperishable ones, for the sake of imperishability.

sanskrit: akravyādā tanvā jātavedo yā te svargā tapasā sayoniḥ | tayaudanam abhiśrāmyaitaṃ tayā no agne mahi śarma yaccha ||
english: O Jātavedas, with that body of thine that does not devour raw flesh, that heavenly form of thine, akin to austerity — with that form cook this odana offering; with it, O Agni, grant us great shelter.

sanskrit: somasyāṃśubhir yatam addhvam adityāḥ pṛṣṭhe sīdata | ye ta odana devayāne loke viduḥ pātraṃ dārumayaṃ manuṣyāḥ | teṣām edhi pātramātraḥ svargaḥ pṛthivīṃ vidma tava pātram ||
english: Purified by the rays of Soma, O you who have eaten, be seated on the back of Āditya. Those among men who know the wooden vessel of thee, the odana, in the celestial world — for them may heaven be as great as the vessel. We know Earth as thy vessel, O odana.

sanskrit: etās tvaudanopa yantv āpo ghṛtaścutaḥ payasā vardhayantīḥ | stabhnāsi svaḥ pṛthivīm uta dyām utāntarikṣaṃ svadhayā pūrayāsi ||
english: May these waters, dripping with ghee, approach thee, O odana, augmenting thee with milk. Thou dost prop heaven, thou dost prop Earth and the atmosphere; with svādhā thou dost fill them.

sanskrit: yāvantās taṇḍulās ta rtasya viṣṭhās tāvanto yajñās ta rtasya dohāḥ | tāvatī svadhā ghṛtapṛṣṭho me astu- -ūrjaṃ duhāṃ madhupṛcaṃ vyoman ||
english: As many grains of rice as are the foundations of thy cosmic order, so many sacrifices are the milkings of that order. So great may the svādhā be for me — the one whose back is ghee — milking vital strength mixed with honey in the vault of heaven.

sanskrit: yam odanaṃ pacāmi śraddadhānaḥ pātrīpūraṃ ghṛtapṛṣṭhaṃ juṣāṇaḥ | sa me mā kṣeṣṭa sadam aśyamāno yamasya loke parame vyoman ||
english: The odana which I cook with faith, filling the vessel, delighting in the one whose back is ghee — may it not be exhausted for me, ever being eaten, in the world of Yama, in the highest heaven.

sanskrit: odanaḥ pātreṇa saha dakṣiṇayā brāhmaṇebhyo datto amṛtatve dadhāti | sūryasya dhrājīr anu raśmīn āgan divas pṛṣṭhān śakuna iva rohan ||
english: The odana, given together with the vessel and the sacrificial fee to Brāhmaṇas, establishes one in immortality. It has gone along the courses of the Sun, along his rays — ascending the back of heaven like a bird.

sanskrit: saṃ prāṇena prāṇabhṛtaṃ sṛjāmi saṃ vīryeṇa payasāśiṣā ca | āstāvaṃ gaccha sukṛtāṃ yatra lokaṃ te tvā prāśnantu dakṣiṇato niṣadya ||
english: I release thee together with breath among the living, together with vitality, with milk, and with blessing. Go to the place of praise, to the world of those who have done good; may they eat of thee, seated to the south.

sanskrit: agniṣṭomena sarathaṃ hi yāhy athoktam atirātraṃ ca gaccha | dvirātramātras tryahaṃ vy aśnuhy athā roha catūrātraṃ ratham iva ||
english: For thou goest on the same chariot as the Agniṣṭoma sacrifice; then go also to the recited Atirātra. Being of the measure of two nights, pervade the three-day rite; then ascend the four-night rite as though mounting a chariot.

sanskrit: catūrātreṇa kalpamāno hi yāhy atha saptarātraṃ daśarātraṃ ca gaccha | dvādaśāhaṃ paribhūya viśvata ekaviṃśatyā vi mṛdho nudasva ||
english: Being consecrated by the four-night rite, advance; then go to the seven-night and the ten-night rite. Having encompassed the twelve-day rite on all sides, thrust away adversaries with the twenty-one-fold.

sanskrit: ekaviṃśatyā vi mṛdho hi yāhy athaikacatvāriṃśatopa yāhi ekam | trayastriṃśatāmṛto bhūtvā trimāsyam odanānv ārabhasva ||
english: Having thrust away adversaries with the twenty-one-fold, then approach the forty-one-day rite, one at a time. Having become immortal through the thirty-three-fold, take hold of the odana of the three-month rite.

sanskrit: idāvatsaraṃ ca parivatsaraṃ ca bradhnasya viṣṭapi parame vyoman | nākena nākam abhi saṃ bhavaudana ||
english: The year and the full year, in the realm of Bradhna in the highest heaven — O odana, become one with the vault of heaven upon vault of heaven.

sanskrit: sādhyā nayantu mukhato mamaitam ādityā rudrā vasavaḥ sacetasaḥ | viśve devā ṛtubhiḥ saṃvidānā imaṃ rakṣantu sadam apramādam ||
english: May the Sādhyas lead this of mine forward from the front; the Ādityas, the Rudras, the Vasus, of one mind — may all the gods, united through the seasons, ever guard this with undivided attention.

sanskrit: idāvatsaraṃ ca parivatsaraṃ ca saṃvatsaram ahorātrāṇi māsaḥ | sūryasyāgneś candramaso 'nubhūtim vātasyābhūtim anv ābhavaudana ||
english: The year, the full year, and the complete year — days and nights, months — O odana, follow upon the experience of the Sun, of Agni, of the Moon, the becoming of Vāyu.

sanskrit: yam īḍate pitaro yaṃ ca devāḥ purohitaṃ tapasā brahmaṇā ca | svadhām ūrjam akṣitim ā juhomi vāte deve pavamāne bṛhaspatau ||
english: Him whom the Pitṛs worship, whom the gods worship as purohita, through austerity and sacred knowledge — svādhā, vital strength, imperishability I offer into Vāyu the god, into Pavamāna, into Bṛhaspati.

sanskrit: caturdhety odanaḥ kalpamāna ūrjā devān svadhā pitṝn | śarīraṃ manuṣyān āśitaṃbhavo brāhmaṇān so 'smākam astu parame vyoman ||
english: Being consecrated fourfold, the odana — with vital strength the gods, with svādhā the Pitṛs, with bodily nourishment mankind, becoming food for the Brāhmaṇas — may it be ours in the highest heaven.

sanskrit: ayaṃ panthā odana devayāno anāruddho mṛtyunā tena yāhi | adabdhaḥ svato nihitaḥ sukṛdbhir brahmaṇā śiṣṭaḥ praśiṣā yamasya so ('smākam astu parame vyoman) ||
english: This path, O odana, the god-faring path, unobstructed by Death — by that path go. Undeceived, established by the virtuous through their own power, ordered by sacred knowledge, by the instruction of Yama — may it be ours in the highest heaven.

sanskrit: yatra te gṛhā odana tat parehi yatrāpāṃ tad u gacchantv āpaḥ | yatra yonim odanaṃ brāhmaṇā viduḥ so asmākam astu parame vyoman ||
english: O odana, wherever thy homes are, go forth thither; let the waters go wherever is the place of the waters. Where the Brāhmaṇas know the womb of the odana — may that be ours in the highest heaven.

sanskrit: hutaṃ te vāci hutam astu cakṣuṣi hutaṃ vijñāne hutam astu te bale | śrotre prāṇe te hutaṃ prajāmṛtatve te hutaṃ kāme ca hutam astu te ||
english: Offered into thy speech, may it be an oblation; offered into thy sight; offered into thy understanding, may it be offered into thy strength. Offered into thy hearing, into thy breath — offered into thy progeny, into thy immortality, and into thy desire, may it be offered.

sanskrit: yad vāgneyo yadi vāsyaindro yadi māruto yadi vaiśvadevaḥ | yas te agnir nṛmaṇā nāma hṛdyas tasminn eṣa suhuto astv odanaḥ so asmākam astu parame vyoman ||
english: Whether it belongs to Agni, or whether to Indra, whether to Marut, or whether to Viśvedeva — the Agni within thee whose name is Nṛmaṇas, the heart-dweller: into him may this odana be well offered; may it be ours in the highest heaven.

sanskrit: ya āviveśa nṛmaṇā manuṣyām̐ agnīnām agniḥ prathamo vayodhāḥ ||
english: He who has entered mankind as Nṛmaṇas — the Agni of Agnis, the first, the sustainer of life.
